description: This is a test source file written in Kotlin, executing unit tests for the GatewayConfigResolver functionality. It includes multiple test cases for parsing gateway endpoints, resolving setup codes, and configuring gateway connection parameters in the context of an Android application.

classes.name: GatewayConfigResolverTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the correctness of gateway configuration parsing and resolution functions.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointUsesDefaultTlsPortForBareWssUrls
methods.description: Tests that a bare wss URL defaults to port 443 with TLS enabled and correct host parsing.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Verifies that non-loopback ws URLs with cleartext are rejected (null result).

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsTailnetCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Ensures tailnet URLs are rejected if not loopback.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointOmitsExplicitDefaultTlsPortFromDisplayUrl
methods.description: Checks that URLs with explicit default TLS port omit the port in the display URL.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Confirms that loopback ws URLs are parsed successfully with correct host, port, and display URL.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLocalhostCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Validates localhost ws URLs are correctly parsed.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsAndroidEmulatorCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that Android emulator IP addresses are allowed.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsPrivateLanCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests private LAN IP addresses in ws URLs are accepted.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsMdnsCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Confirms mDNS style URLs are accepted.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Verifies IPv6 loopback URLs are correctly handled.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv4MappedIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Checks IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback addresses in ws URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsCleartextLoopbackPrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures URLs with bypass hosts are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Verifies IPv6 addresses that are not loopback are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests IPv6 link-local addresses with zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
methods.description: Validates secure wss URLs with IPv6 zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv4CleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Ensures URLs to 0.0.0.0 are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Checks that unspecified IPv6 addresses are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Allows loopback HTTP URLs.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsRawSetupCode
methods.description: Test that a raw setup code string is accepted as-is.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsQrJsonPayload
methods.description: Test JSON payload HTML with embedded setup code is correctly resolved.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Checks that invalid input strings are rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithInvalidSetupCode
methods.description: Ensures JSON with invalid setupCode field is rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithNonStringSetupCode
methods.description: Checks rejection of JSON where setupCode is not a string.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextGateway
methods.description: Verifies that non-loopback URLs are rejected for setup codes.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Tests that insecure remote URLs get an error indicating insecurity.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Checks that insecure gateway endpoint URLs are flagged correctly.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultAcceptsLanCleartextGateway
methods.description: Validates LAN addresses are parsed successfully with correct config.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCodeParsesBootstrapToken
methods.description: Test decoding of a setup code payload with a bootstrap token.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigPrefersBootstrapTokenFromSetupCode
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap token from setup code is used when resolving connection config.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigDefaultsPortlessWssSetupCodeTo443
methods.description: Checks that a URL without specified port defaults to 443 when using WSS.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualPreservesBootstrapTokenWhenNoReplacementAuthExists
methods.description: Verifies bootstrap token is preserved during manual config resolution if no new credentials are provided.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenNoReplacementPasswordExists
methods.description: Tests bootstrap token removal in favor of password when password is provided.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenEndpointChanges
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap token is cleared if the endpoint host changes.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigAllowsPrivateLanManualCleartextEndpoint
methods.description: Confirms private LAN manual endpoints are accepted and configured properly.
